profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Zumba | DDD · Clean Architecture | Building maintainable systems at scale.
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience building and shipping consumer-facing products across web and mobile. Currently at Zumba, where I've helped scale platforms serving millions of users in 186 countries — working across PHP, Python, Vue.js, React Native, MySQL and Redis.
 
I've owned features end-to-end across the full stack — from migrating OAuth infrastructure with zero downtime, to building checkout and subscription flows with Stripe, to designing third-party integration pipelines for partners like Wellhub and Noom. I push for clean, maintainable systems (DDD, Clean Architecture) and approach every problem thinking about what the team maintaining it will need six months from now.
 
I treat AI-assisted development as a core engineering skill — I've built custom Cursor agents, designed app architecture with LLM context in mind, and used tools like Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery across the team.
 
Beyond code, I mentor engineers, onboard new team members, and advocate for practices that help teams ship with confidence. I'm looking for my next challenge — a senior engineering role where I can have outsized impact on product, architecture, and team culture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to migrating Zumba's consumer mobile app from native code to React Native within a 7-person cross-functional team, leveraging AI-assisted workflows (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to bridge skill gaps and accelerate delivery — shipped to production in early 2026.

Designed the app's architecture with LLM context in mind, and built custom Cursor skills and agents to streamline team workflows — including a Jira integration for ticket-driven development, a PR review skill, and an in-IDE tool for addressing PR comments without context switching.

Migrated OAuth token storage from MongoDB to Redis with a dual-read/write strategy for zero-downtime transition, and managed the subscription lifecycle system — resolving race conditions, deduplicating records, and handling edge cases across delinquent and reactivated users.

Owned the consumer checkout and subscription experience end-to-end — A/B tested pricing layouts, personalized flows based on user goals, built cancellation retention flows with tiered offers, and integrated Stripe billing with automated plan management.

Built and maintained the API layer powering the consumer app (PHP/CakePHP) — on-demand video categories, user profiles, workout scheduling, fitness stats, class reminders — plus a calorie prediction API and Apple Watch data ingestion pipeline with gamification triggers.

Designed and implemented third-party integrations with Wellhub and Noom, including custom OAuth grant types, webhook processing pipelines, and subscription lifecycle management for partner-sourced users.

Helped reduce churn during COVID-19 by integrating Zoom into the instructor class system for online teaching, and building a live streaming platform with student management and Stripe-based payouts.

Mentored engineers on core design principles including Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture, and played an active role in onboarding new team members to the codebase and workflows.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented an automated translation system, saving approximately 40 man-hours per week.

Integrated Prismic as a headless CMS to manage static content across the company's websites, enabling business teams to update content independently without engineering involvement.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked directly with clients to gather requirements and deliver custom WordPress and e-commerce solutions for small and medium businesses.

Managed full project lifecycles from client discovery through delivery, handling both technical implementation and stakeholder communication.
